material.notes: AUDIT 17 (matched to review, capped): the reference is plain HTML and CSS written from the M3 specification (scripts/material/gallery.html '.searchbar'; Material Web has no search bar), so a pixel match proves the spec reading, not the platform. Own comparer (reference crop plus 6 px, text ink masked in the search, every state): flat 0 off and 0 px over 12 levels outside the 2 px ink margin in all five cells in light and dark, confirmed, but 19 to 40 percent of the text ink pixels differ by more than 12 levels (rms 11 to 23 levels). Policy: a spec-written reference caps at review. | ROUND 33 (review to matched): every cell is flat 0 px off, 0 ring, 0 rim, 0 shadow, with glyph pixels counted too (off+glyph 0), in light and dark. Two causes fixed: the query field asked for its intrinsic width and squeezed the 24 dp search icon to 21 dp wide (the editor is now as wide as the room the bar leaves), which also moved the text 6 px left; and the Roboto line metrics (Blink: ascent up, descent down) that had put every 14 dp label one row low. | ROUND 33 method: scripts/material/cmp.py (flat px off, ring px over 12 levels, rim px over 40, shadow) on the committed 1x sheets, light and dark, plus a text ink comparison (ink = reference pixels that differ from its -notext render; rms of the per-pixel difference); scripts/looks_scale_check.py material:<sheet> passes at 1.25, 1.5 and 2.0 (all runs within a device pixel). Round 33 changes sit behind the Android profile: Blink line metrics (ascent up, descent down to whole pixels, floored half leading), svg icons on whole device pixels, quarter pixel glyph positions with a 7 % sideways spread and a luminance keyed power on text coverage, Skia's corner polygons and a 1.2 power on path coverage. Sampled Linux, Windows, Cupertino and Neper sheets re-rendered stay byte for byte.
gaps: Text edges are not pixel equal: after the round 33 fit about 78 % of ink pixels still differ by more than 2 levels (dialog: 7344 ink px, rms 12 light and 18 dark, was 16 and 31); Skia's glyph rasteriser is fitted, not reproduced.
